svg.title: Silicon Soul v2.0 PCB floorplan and proposed net list — Gate 2
svg.desc: A conceptual top-side floorplan on the existing 200 by 160 coordinate frame, with the ESP32-WROOM-32 built-in antenna at the north edge, fixed mounting holes, left 10-pin header and bottom-centre USB-C, plus proposed power, USB-UART, reset, switch, display and buzzer nets.
svg.text: EXISTING SVG FRAME · 200 × 160 UNITS · NOT FABRICATION SCALE

g.text: Fixed: outline, 4 holes, J1 left, J2 bottom-centre, U1, LED1/LED2, DeKUT mark.
ANT1 uses U1’s module antenna at the top edge; no separate meander trace.
Component placement only. Copper routing is intentionally not shown.
LOGICAL CONNECTIONS FOR REVIEW · NOT YET ROUTED
LED1: VBUS via R5 1k · LED2: 3V3 via R6 1k
C3 10µF input bypass at VR1; verify with chosen buck datasheet.
J2.D+ / D− → U3 USBLC6-2 → U2 CH340C
R3 EN 10k + C4 100nF to GND · R4 IO0 10k pull-up
SW1 UP GPIO32 · SW2 LEFT GPIO25
SW3 RIGHT GPIO26 · SW4 DOWN GPIO33
SW5 ROTATE GPIO27 · SW6 DROP GPIO14
All active-low to GND; use ESP32 internal pull-ups.
J1’s 10-pin physical position is fixed; pinout awaits approval.
SCLK GPIO18 · MOSI GPIO23 · MISO GPIO19*
CS GPIO21 · D/C GPIO22 · RESET GPIO16
* MISO/TE depend on the selected panel/controller.
No panel model was supplied. These are logical net names,
not final FPC pin numbers or approved GPIO connections.
Confirm the LCD datasheet before artwork routing.
BZ1 passive piezo → Q3 low-side driver.
LED1 red = USB 5V · LED2 green = 3V3 rail present.
• VR1 proposed as 3V3 buck (≥1A), replacing the SOT-223 LDO.
At 5V→3.3V and 0.5A, an LDO dissipates about 0.85W.
• Confirm the SPI display assumption and select the panel.
U1 stays WROOM-32 per brief; its datasheet says NRND.

svg.text: SCOPE: concept floorplan only · no fabricated pad numbering, copper paths, or electrical claims are frozen at Gate 2.
Source basis: Espressif ESP32-WROOM-32 datasheet + hardware design guidelines; DevKitC V4 reference schematic; WCH CH340 datasheet; USB-IF Type-C spec; ST USBLC6-2 datasheet.
